indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ql_dash_posts_pkey ON public.ql_dash_posts USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ql_dash_posts_status ON public.ql_dash_posts USING btree (status, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quiz_external_shares_pkey ON public.quiz_external_shares USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX quiz_external_shares_share_token_key ON public.quiz_external_shares USING btree (share_token)
CREATE INDEX quiz_external_shares_owner_item_idx ON public.quiz_external_shares USING btree (owner_user_id, library_id, source_item_id, created_at DESC)

triggers.trigger: CREATE TRIGGER ql_item_limits BEFORE INSERT ON public.student_library_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ql__check_item_limits()
CREATE TRIGGER student_quiz_cleanup AFTER DELETE ON public.student_library_items FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_quiz_cleanup()

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
